From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

German

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Middle High German gewürze, a collective of wurz (“wort, herb, root”), formed around the 14th century. Equivalent to ge- +‎ Wurz. Compare Old High German giwurz f (“spice”) and English wort.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ɡəˈvʏrt͡s], [ɡəˈvʏʁt͡s], [ɡəˈvʏɐ̯t͡s]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

Gewürz n (strong, genitive Gewürzes, plural Gewürze)

  1. spice, condiment, seasoning
